claim_scope: Independent sequential-FEDP numerical source matrices for ordinary WMMA; no GPU execution claimed.

producer.method: Sequential four-product integer/Fraction evaluations with exact raw-bit accumulator handoffs.

application.name: sgemm_tcu
application.dimension_rule: Positive multiples of M=8, N=4, K=8; no tails, padding or arbitrary strides.
application.fixture_input_adapter: Named cases exported by ci/project/p02_wmma_fixtures.py to tests/regression/sgemm_tcu/p02_fixtures.h.

packing.input_order: Consecutive memory elements occupy low then high 16 bits of each word.
packing.a_words: Complete row-major M*K input memory; lda=K elements.
packing.b_words: Complete column-major K*N input memory; ldb=K elements.
packing.expected: Complete row-major M*N FP32 output bits; ldc=N elements.
packing.hex_encoding: Eight lowercase hexadecimal digits per 32-bit word, without a prefix.

arithmetic.fedp_order: Ascending K in groups of four; each returned FP32 bit pattern becomes the next C.
arithmetic.intermediate_expected: K/4 FP32 results shared by every output, after each ascending four-product group.
arithmetic.fedp_trace: Representative output's packed operands, incoming C, and full independent leaf derivation at each step.
arithmetic.arbitrary_initial_c_coverage: Leaf-only; all WMMA cases here initialize C to positive zero.

coverage.cross_tile_order: Four K16 cases detect reversal of complete K8 tiles while preserving quartet order within each tile.
coverage.signed_ftz: The lifted quartet is last so a following zero FEDP cannot canonicalize a negative FTZ zero.
coverage.layout_companion: ci/project/fixtures/p02_layout_v1.json supplies distinct rows, columns and multiple tiles.

cases.derivation: K=0..3 contributes zero; K=4..7 repeats the frozen zero-C leaf products. Keeping the leaf quartet last preserves signed output FTZ bits. All five terms are zero; the integer sum emits +0.

K=0..3 contributes zero; K=4..7 repeats the frozen zero-C leaf products. Keeping the leaf quartet last preserves signed output FTZ bits. 1 - 1 + minsub leaves an exact minsub; retention depends on the common quantum 2^-24.

K=0..3 contributes zero; K=4..7 repeats the frozen zero-C leaf products. Keeping the leaf quartet last preserves signed output FTZ bits. maxfinite - maxfinite + minsub has exact residual minsub; the residual is lost before cancellation, so TFR emits +0.

K=0..3 contributes zero; K=4..7 repeats the frozen zero-C leaf products. Keeping the leaf quartet last preserves signed output FTZ bits. minsub*1 preserves the input's exact value before output rounding and signed FTZ.

K=0..3 contributes zero; K=4..7 repeats the frozen zero-C leaf products. Keeping the leaf quartet last preserves signed output FTZ bits. minsub^2 is exact before FP32 conversion; FP16 yields 2^-48, while BF16 is below the FP32 range.

K=0..3 constructs FP32 accumulator 3f800000 from low-precision products and C=+0. K=4..7 applies the frozen leaf products to that returned accumulator. 1 + 2^-24 is halfway; the even lower endpoint wins.

K=0..3 constructs FP32 accumulator 3fffffff from low-precision products and C=+0. K=4..7 applies the frozen leaf products to that returned accumulator. 2 - 2^-23 + 2^-24 is halfway; rounding carries into exponent 1.

K=0..3 constructs FP32 accumulator 3f800000. K=4..7 adds the same-sign 2^-24 half ULP and ties to even, retaining that accumulator. K=8..11 cancels it exactly; K=12..15 contributes zero. Reversing the two complete K8 tiles preserves each tile's quartet order but returns 33800000 instead of +0. Independently rounded tile sums also return +0; this case distinguishes tile order, not independent tile rounding.
